# Source comparison

Comparison complete: every factual and attributed claim in the complete draft has been checked against the supplied brief and material in source.md. One finding.

## 1. An absence of a claim becomes a claim of absence

Draft: “Öppna beslut has neither costed nor funded this proposal.”

Source: “Föreningen gör inget anspråk på att ha finansierat eller kostnadsberäknat försöket. Kostnaden behöver kommunstyrelsen ta ställning till.”

The source says the association makes no claim to have funded or costed the trial. It does not establish that neither activity has happened. The draft converts an explicit limit on what is claimed into categorical knowledge of what has not happened.

Smallest supported repair: “Öppna beslut makes no claim to have costed or funded this proposal.” Retain the following sentences about the board assessing the cost and the trial not being assumed cost-free.

No other findings.
